tasks.title: Build Kohakuyasha v0.1.0 local Windows foundation
tasks.result: Portable bootstrap, core, SQLite, tray, watchdog, Russian web UI, autostart, diagnostics and tests implemented.

tasks.title: Validate Kohakuyasha v0.1.3 on physical Windows
acceptance: Kohakuyasha.bat launches from a removable drive
Pinned portable Python downloads when no suitable system Python exists
Tray icon and asynchronous menu actions work
Browser opens the local UI and protected API works
Autostart works with Cyrillic/spaced paths and survives drive-letter change
Restart succeeds repeatedly without watchdog loop

tasks.title: Security and reliability hardening v0.1.1
tasks.result: Closed browser-origin attack surface, hardened runtime/bootstrap/restart/database/config/tray/UI, separated dev tests and expanded automated coverage to 17 tests.

tasks.title: Establish Windows and Linux CI baseline v0.1.2
tasks.result: Added GitHub Actions validation on Windows and Linux with pinned Python 3.13.16; CI exposed and fixed Windows SQLite handle locking and PowerShell 5.1 UTF-8 BOM compatibility. Final run passed on both platforms.

tasks.title: Audit fixes v0.1.3
tasks.result: Fixed diagnostics status leak/concurrency, deferred restart/shutdown replies, event trim cost, restart port drift, bind race retry, soft internet check, read-only marker crash; tests 17 -> 27.

tasks.title: Avatar widget: chat (left click), AI cabinet (right click), draggable across all modules v0.2.0
tasks.result: Global draggable avatar with persisted position, chat with SQLite history, cabinet from CHARACTER.json; schema v2; websockets dependency fixed.

tasks.title: AI memory: extract facts from chat into SQLite and manage them in the cabinet
acceptance: facts injected into the system prompt
memory tab in cabinet with edit/delete
tasks.result: Memory: dialog/notes import (JSON, JSONL, ChatGPT/Claude exports, text), SQLite FTS5 retrieval injected into the system prompt, learn-from-chat toggle, cabinet Memory tab. Automatic fact extraction and embeddings remain future work.

tasks.title: Chat UI, cabinet tabs, avatar visualization and AI settings v0.3.0
tasks.result: ChatGPT-style chat, cabinet (Profile/Avatar/AI/System), face-only avatar with shape options, provider settings with local key store and working Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible calls.

tasks.title: UI overhaul v0.4.0: sidebar cleanup, themes, clock+calendar, avatar uploads/behavior, resizable panels, Cloud.ru, memory import
Semantic memory (embeddings) and automatic fact extraction
Design pass v0.5.0: kitsune style, unified components, theme contrast, cabinet polish, chat day separators and Stop
